summary: Pangasinan 1st District representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Authored travel-tax abolition and a tax code amendment; co-authored gig-economy regulation, higher income-tax exemption, fuel-tax relief, a disinformation measure and prison contraband penalties.
caveat: Mostly co-authored. Disinformation and contraband bills are one-issue each and left unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored gig-economy regulation (-2) against authored travel-tax abolition (+2) and co-authored higher income-tax exemption and fuel-tax relief (-1 to 0). Mild left lean on thin evidence.
